Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a pull-down (AP-MS) approach to identify interactors of the periostin C-terminal domain. Acquisition is DDA based on the use of SequestHT and Proteome Discoverer for peptide identification from an Orbitrap Eclipse. Quantification is explicitly stated as label-free (LFQ).

scope: To identify potential interaction partners of periostin CTD, the recombinant PN FL, PN ΔCTD, and PN CTD were used as bait, and the conditioned medium from differentiated NTERT1 cells treated with IL-4/-13 was used as pull-down matrix.
MagStrep “type 3” XT 5% bead suspension (IBA Lifesciences) was coupled with 0.85 nmol of PN FL, PN ΔCTD, or PN CTD following the manufacturer’s protocol.

Coupled beads were incubated with 500 µL pull-down matrix for 60 min at RT rotating and were washed in 3 × 200 µL buffer A1 before interaction partners were eluted in 2 × 25 µL Buffer BXT (IBA Lifesciences).
Tryptic digests of eluates for LC–MS/MS analysis were performed on spin filters to remove biotin.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct proteomics components: 1) a differential analysis of the NTERT1 conditioned medium (treated vs untreated) and 2) a pull-down interactome study. Per the prompt instructions, only the perturbation/differential variable (IL-4/IL-13 stimulation) is extracted as the primary biological variable. The pull-down baits (PN FL, PN ΔCTD, PN CTD) are used to define interaction partners rather than as a biological treatment perturbation of the cell system.
